facts.fact: The DHIS2 country profile says DHIS2 has been used as Guinea Bissau's national health management information system since 2013, covering routine data on a range of health programs.

The DHIS2 country profile says DHIS2 is also used in Guinea Bissau for disease surveillance and ITN campaign planning, and DHIS2 Tracker programs serve as electronic registries for maternal and child health and immunization.

systems.country_label: maternal and child health and immunization registries
